profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Adobe
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer interested in all aspects and methodology of the modern development process. Professional experience in JavaScript/TypeScript (NodeJS, NextJS, React, Webpack), Redis, SQL, and CI/CD pipelines (AWS/Terraform, Jenkins, Kubernetes).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer 5
positions.description: Team lead on GenAI & Firefly projects

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Full-Stack developer for Behance

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack engineer developing websites in AngularJS, React, NextJS, with stacks including TypeScript, Webpack, MySQL, and Redis. Created and maintained DevOps pipelines in Kubernetes, Jenkins, and AWS + terraform.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: CS 390NIP - Undergraduate TA for Neural Image Processing in Python, PyTorch + Tensorflow. Assisted students in learning how to write neural networks to process images.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: CS 252 - TA for Systems Programming course in C/C++. Assisted students in learning how to write low-level programs, such as a memory allocator (malloc), a UNIX shell implementation, and a HTTPS web server implementation

positions.title: Head Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: CS 390VR - Head Teaching Assistant in Virtual Reality Applications Course. Gave Lectures on how to develop for various VR systems (Oculus Quest, Vive, Index) in the Unity engine with C#.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Designed and developed cloud monitoring infrastructure to measure website performance across multiple configurable workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked with ETL tools such as Talend to create data ingestion systems for poorly formatted large datasets. Created custom talend nodes in Java to assist data cleaning

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Full-Stack development creating tools to visualize Big Data & graph data in the browser using D3.js

honors.title: 2018 ACM Richard Tapia Celebration of Diversity in Computing Scholarship
